lines: Peace be with you, neighbor. Oh, forgive me, I am in such a state.
The children ran past the well and sent my water jar rolling off like a lamb let loose. I cannot leave my washing to chase it.
Bless you! It rolled off toward the olive grove, south and west of here, past the pond. Look among the trees.
Of course. Everyone has their own work. If you change your mind, I will be here.
Any sign of my jar? It went toward the olive grove, south and west, beyond the pond.
My jar! And not a crack in it. The Lord is kind, and so are you.
Here, take these two lepta. It is not much, but it is honestly meant.
Have you spoken to Yosef yet? The trader, by the market stall. He has come up from the Jordan road with the strangest tale. You were always the curious one.
Thank you again for the jar. And mind the road, if you go east. A great many people are on it.
